_comment: Box-select three regiments of different size (Spearmen spawn TIGHT, Infantry NORMAL, Archers LOOSE by default) and drag a flank line to split them under the new default mode -- equal depth, space basis: every regiment forms up to the same PHYSICAL depth. Tight is synaspismos (spacing_scale 1.0), Normal pyknosis (2.0), Loose open order (4.0), so the split is density-driven. A custom no-enemy scenario isolates the split mechanic from any combat.

overlap.reason: Mid-deploy proximity while the drag-line re-forms all three regiments: soldiers funnel past each other in transit, and sampled minimum neighbour distances dip under the floor. Pre-existing on the merge-base of this clip (measured there: uid0 worst 0.06 wu, uid1 worst 1.01 wu), not introduced by the pitch change. Uid 1 is no longer exempted: since the same-unit standoff runs in a reform hold while any man stands more than a file pitch off his slot, uid 1 passes on every seed (0.08 on main), and uid 0 reads 1.95 wu on every seed (0.05 on main). Traced on seed 0: uid 0 comes closest at tick 294 in its REFORM hold, men a mean 20 wu off their slots, where the pass runs but pushes apart no faster than its bounded speed. Men of one block walking through each other is #1894. Measured 2026-11-04 on 47428369 against main bec0b16e with full state dumps every 2 ticks, every exemption removed, seeds 0 to 4.

path_crossing.reason: The clip's whole subject is a drag-line form-up that re-slots three regiments onto a new line, so routes cross by construction. uid0 (Spearmen) already fails on the merge-base (worst 0.87 there); uid1 (Infantry) joins above the threshold once Normal doubles its pitch and its men travel farther across the widening grid.
